method: Current MoonBit implementation in fresh processes, sequential scenarios; summary is median of process medians. Min/max span process medians, not individual operations.

samples.scope: Public portable-file parsing and portableProject capture, size checks, metadata validation and source deduplication. Embedded sizes are base64 characters; payloads exercise validation, not decoding. Room URL I/O is stubbed to one tiny Blob per unique source. No browser, codec, disk or network; JSON.stringify for parse input is outside timing, portableProject internal stringify/copy is included.
samples.iterations: One assertion call, two warmup + seven measured batches of three operations per case.
